item.title: [+1] Rubio kicks off India visit with trade deal, Russian oil on agenda
item.description:

Related: “‘India may overtake US as top Scotch whisky market by value as tariff cuts spur premium demand’”. Ongoing: also reported on 4 of the previous 7 days (first 18 Oct).
